sources.note: The record's official_source_url, read in full. DCU Global's own page for the DCU International Scholarships for Non-EU Students 2027-28 on dcu.ie; page footer shows 'Last updated: 1 week 6 days ago'. Covers the DCU Merit Scholarship for Non-EU Students plus faculty scholarships for Humanities and Social Sciences, Engineering and Computing, Business School, and Science and Health.
DCU Registry 'How to Apply to DCU' page, read to corroborate the record's deadline_date of 2027-07-01: 'The closing date for international undergraduate programmes is 1st July.'

awarding_body.detail: The page is Dublin City University's own, published on dcu.ie under DCU Global; it is not a news article, student blog, aggregator or Wikipedia mirror. It covers the DCU Merit Scholarship for Non-EU Students and the four faculty international scholarships.
awarding_body.quote: DCU offers partial merit-based scholarships to some non-EU students.

deadline.detail: The scholarship page publishes no scholarship deadline and states consideration is automatic on applying as a non-EU student, exactly as the record's deadline_label states. The record's deadline_date 2027-07-01 is the operative admissions deadline for the 2027-28 cycle: DCU Registry's How to Apply page states the closing date for international undergraduate programmes is 1st July, i.e. 1 July 2027 for 2027-28 entry. The cycle is the currently-open one (page content is for 2027-28 and was updated about two weeks ago).
deadline.quote: You are automatically considered for a scholarship when you apply as a non-EU student to DCU. We'll let you know if you have qualified for a scholarship when we contact you to advise if your application to study at DCU has been successful.

eligibility.detail: All claims confirmed: open to non-EU nationals; consideration is automatic on application with no separate scholarship application; awards are restricted to the eligible programme codes listed per faculty for 2027-28; full-time study. The Humanities and Social Sciences award is additionally described as merit-based for high-achieving applicants holding an offer.
eligibility.quote: All Non-EU applications to a full-time undergraduate programme in the Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences are automatically considered for this scholarship, and the reduction in fee will be applied directly to the student account.

funding.detail: Confirmed as tuition-fee funding, partial. Awards are partial merit-based reductions of the full-time 2027-2028 Non-EU tuition fee, ranging from EUR 1,850 (Humanities and Social Sciences undergraduate) to EUR 6,100 (Science and Health undergraduate), applied directly to the student account. Not fully funded; no living-cost, travel or stipend component, none of which the record claims.
funding.quote: Successful recipients will receive a €6,100 fee reduction on the full-time 2027–2028 Non-EU Tuition fee.

degree_levels.detail: Confirmed: the page lists eligible undergraduate programmes (BA, BSc, BEng, Bachelor of Civil Law) and eligible postgraduate taught programmes (MSc, MEng) for 2027-28, matching the record's 'Undergraduate, Postgraduate Taught'. No PhD or research programmes are listed under these scholarships.
degree_levels.quote: This scholarship is available to Non-EU applicants who have received an offer to study on a Masters or Bachelor programme in the Faculty of Engineering and Computing.

recommended_field_updates.deadline_text: No scholarship deadline is published; consideration is automatic on applying as a non-EU student to DCU. The operative date is the DCU international admissions deadline for the 2027-28 cycle (closing date 1st July for international undergraduate programmes per DCU Registry; postgraduate applicants should check programme-level deadlines).
recommended_field_updates.verification_notes: Re-read live on 2026-10-12; page live and current for 2027-28. All eligible programme codes and per-faculty reduction amounts (EUR 1,850 to EUR 6,100) agree with the record, including DC204 BSc Athletic Therapy and Training at EUR 3,100 and the EUR 4,500 Science and Health Psychology awards. The deadline_date 2027-07-01 is the international undergraduate admissions closing date, not a scholarship deadline. Next re-check should re-read the page when DCU rolls it to the 2028-29 cycle: amounts and eligible programme codes change annually and the URL year suffix must be updated.

notes_for_reviewer: Record confirmed as active. Minor caveat for the next cycle: the deadline_date reflects the admissions application deadline rather than a scholarship deadline, so postgraduate applicants should be pointed at programme-level deadlines on the DCU Registry admissions pages. The record's 'Tuition Fee Waiver' funding label is substantiated but the awards are partial reductions (EUR 1,850-6,100), not full tuition waivers, and are not fully funded.
